advanced_analysis.calibration: Saved test probabilities and labels are for evaluation only; fit calibration with validation/training data, never with test labels.
advanced_analysis.confidence_intervals: Across-repeat intervals use the five dependent scaffold repeats descriptively; pilot has one holdout and no interval.

conformal.instruction: Generate dedicated train/validation calibration predictions before estimating nonconformity quantiles. Do not populate from held-out test labels.

advanced_analysis.full_run_novelty_source: frozen scaffold test_novelty values from data/splits/herg_karim_scaffold.json
advanced_analysis.novelty_vs_performance: Full-run rows include frozen structural_novelty and novelty_bin; pilot rows have null novelty because their holdout was sampled within scaffold_r0 training.
advanced_analysis.selection_integrity: No test metric was used for hyperparameter selection or threshold choice; selection audit was checked against validation tuning_trials.csv.
advanced_analysis.shap: Use saved split checkpoint and its matching feature representation; no SHAP values were computed.

full.test_set_use: Final evaluation only; no test metric or label is used for model selection or threshold choice.

pilot.test_set_use: Final evaluation only; no test metric or label is used for model selection or threshold choice.

confidence_interval.caveat: Full repeats share molecules; intervals are descriptive, not superiority tests. A single pilot holdout has undefined SD and CI.
confidence_interval.method: two-sided Student-t interval across split-level metrics

figures.description: Counts of curated non-blockers and blockers from the frozen hERG_Karim feature metadata.
figures.title: Curated class distribution

figures.description: All documented RDKit descriptor values, shown separately by class; no feature scaling or selection is applied.
figures.title: RDKit descriptor distributions by class

figures.description: Top 20 non-empty scaffold groups, a combined long-tail group, and molecules without a scaffold. Exact scaffold counts are in scaffold_counts.csv.
figures.title: Scaffold distribution

figures.description: Counts and positive rates for each of the five frozen scaffold repeats. The evaluation partitions are shown for descriptive analysis only.
figures.title: Class balance across train, validation, and test

figures.description: Chirality-aware ECFP4 (radius 2, 2048 bits): a deterministic sample of unique random molecule pairs and nearest-neighbor similarities for a deterministic query sample. Sampling details and raw values are recorded in molecular_similarity_sample.csv.
figures.title: Molecular similarity distributions

figures.description: Each curve is the mean interpolated ROC across held-out split predictions; full-run ribbons show one split standard deviation. Pilot curves use only the training-partition holdout.
figures.title: Full ROC curves

figures.description: Each curve is the mean interpolated precision-recall curve across held-out split predictions; full-run ribbons show one split standard deviation. Pilot curves are not independent test performance.
figures.title: Full precision-recall curves

figures.description: Mean held-out auroc by model with descriptive t-based 95% confidence intervals across repeats; pilot intervals are undefined for a single holdout.
figures.title: Full AUROC comparison

figures.description: Mean held-out auprc by model with descriptive t-based 95% confidence intervals across repeats; pilot intervals are undefined for a single holdout.
figures.title: Full AUPRC comparison

figures.description: Positive-class, macro, and weighted F1 computed from validation-selected thresholds; bars show means and descriptive 95% t intervals where repeats permit.
figures.title: Full F1-score comparison

figures.description: Mean held-out mcc by model with descriptive t-based 95% confidence intervals across repeats; pilot intervals are undefined for a single holdout.
figures.title: Full MCC comparison

figures.description: Counts are summed across held-out predictions using validation-selected thresholds. Full-repeat test molecules overlap across repeats, so pooled counts are descriptive, not independent observations.
figures.title: Full confusion matrices

selection_audit.method: For each model and split, the recorded selected trial was verified to attain the maximum validation AUROC and match the saved selected parameters; saved thresholds are the baseline's validation-selected thresholds.
selection_audit.test_role: Test predictions and labels were read only to calculate final metrics and figures.
